questions.prompt: True or false: “Because he was both a Ph.D. and a century, King was sometimes called the Reverend Doctor Martin Luther King Jr., or just Dr King.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
